articles.highlight: 两起独立大规模枪击事件造成至少27人死亡，其中约翰内斯堡附近酒吧17人、开普敦附近烧烤场10人。
articles.summary: 《卫报》报道，南非两座最大城市附近发生两起独立大规模枪击，合计至少27人死亡。约翰内斯堡西南Wedela镇酒吧袭击中17人死亡、至少15人受伤，开普敦附近烧烤场另有10人死亡。报道提到南非谋杀率居全球前列，并正调查警察内部腐败与犯罪问题，这有助于理解治安与执法治理的严峻背景。

At least 15 other people sustained gunshot injuries in that attack, police said.

articles.title: The Weasel and the Meaning of It All: Annie Dillard on How to Live
articles.highlight: 假如我们对存在的最重要问题给出肯定回答，那么只剩一个问题：我们该如何度过这一生？
articles.summary: 文章借安妮·迪拉德对如何生活的追问，从存在是否值得肯定转向一个更棘手的问题：人生具体该怎么过。它提醒我们，哲学、诗歌、经典与自助术都无法让沉默而冷漠的生命给出答案，而能够自我指涉的意识又让人不满足于仅仅活着。值得一读，因为它把宏大的意义问题落回到每个人都要面对的生活选择。
articles.failureAnalysis: 核心要点是：即使确认生命值得过，如何生活仍无现成答案；人只能带着意识带来的不满，在实践中寻找自己的活法。
articles.sourceExcerpt: Suppose we answer the most important question of existence in the affirmative. There is then only one question remaining: How shall we live this life? Despite all the technologies of thought and feeling we have invented to divine an answer — philosophy and poetry, scripture and self-help — life stares mutely back at us, immense and indifferent, having abled us with opposable thumbs and handicapped us with a consciousness capable of self-reference that renders us dissatisfied with the banality of mere survival.

en.highlight: Suppose we answer the most important question of existence in the affirmative; then only one question remains: How shall we live this life?
en.summary: Drawing on Annie Dillard, this essay asks what remains after we affirm that existence is meaningful: how to live this life. It notes that philosophy, poetry, scripture, and self-help cannot make an indifferent universe answer, and that self-aware consciousness can leave us dissatisfied with mere survival. It is worth reading as a compact reflection on living without a final formula.
en.failureAnalysis: The key takeaway is that affirming life does not supply a recipe for living it; self-awareness may make mere survival feel insufficient, so the question of how to live remains one we must answer in practice.

articles.title: How To Stop Getting Taken Advantage Of: 6 Secrets From Game Theory
articles.highlight: 你带着讲道理的姿态走进谈判，准备了多种证明方式，而每一种都意味着自己少拿一些。
articles.summary: 文章从博弈论角度给出6个避免被占便宜的秘诀，开头描述了一种常见困境：你本想讲理并在谈判中让步，对方却不断施压索取更多。它值得读，因为这类策略能帮助人识别不合理博弈并保护自身利益。

articles.sourceExcerpt: You show up to the negotiation wanting to be reasonable. You’ve prepared several ways to demonstrate this, all of which involve receiving less. To make it worse, you’re dealing with the kind of person who’d happily disconnect an orphan’s ventilator to charge his phone.

Notably, the description is the only verified content so far.
en.failureAnalysis: Video editing demands heavy engineering around performance, codec compatibility, and cross-platform rendering, which is hard to sustain without subscription revenue. MCP support is only a claim in the description and may be a conceptual selling point rather than proven workflow value.
en.title: Concat: A Truly Free, Open-Source Cross-Platform CapCut Alternative with MCP Support

articles.summary: 该仓库以案例日志形式记录 MiniMax H3 的提示词工程实验，适合观察提示设计如何被系统化记录和复盘。它获得 118 星标与近期公开活动，说明这类实战型 prompt 工程资料有一定关注度。
articles.failureAnalysis: 若日志只停留在零散案例，缺少可复现评测、版本管理和与模型迭代同步，内容价值会快速折旧。提示词工程与特定模型版本强绑定，MiniMax H3 一旦更新或访问成本变化，旧案例可能失效。没有明确分发、验证和商业化路径时，它更容易停留在个人笔记而非可持续产品。
